title: Export site as ZIP and Backup download dialogs end on a disabled Downloaded button, accept digits only, and keep non-code refusals out of the code step
steps: S1: Drive the Export site as ZIP dialog at 360px through Prepare ZIP, Send code, a six-digit code and Download.
S2: Drive the Backup download dialog through Send code, a six-digit code and Download.
S3: In either dialog type letters into the code field.
S4: Answer POST …/download with a refusal that is not about the code (EXPORT_NOT_READY).
S5: Fail Send code once while the ZIP is ready, then press Try again.
expect: S1: the dialog shows 'Download started.', the primary button reads Downloaded and is disabled, the code field is gone, and every part stays inside the 360px viewport.
S2: same end state: Downloaded disabled, no code field.
S3: no letter is accepted and Download stays disabled.
S4: the destructive failed alert with Try again / Close shows, not the inline wrong-code text.
S5: the code door is called again and no new POST /backup is made.

selectors.tool: node --test browser tests of both dialogs

evidence: Before this change both dialogs returned to the Send code step after the download link was handed to the browser, and every download refusal read as a wrong code
fence: Browser tests against the built plugin bundles with the API doors stubbed; the real code email and download on a stand are not exercised

tests: ZIP: Prepare, Send code, then Download
ZIP: a non-code refusal of the download
ZIP: retrying a failed Send code
a backup download stays complete after the browser receives its link
a non-code refusal enters the destructive download-failed state
retrying a failed Send code request reuses the existing export
